fusions.name: Through the Gaps
fusions.desc: Slips a blade through the gaps in your mesh into an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 26 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bladed Fling
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh strung with hidden blades that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Cut Yourself Loose
fusions.desc: Cuts through the mesh holding you, removing up to 3 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Knotted Blade
fusions.desc: Conjures a blade knotted into a mesh cord: your weapon damage rises by 10%, your critical hits deal 12% more, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a tick for 3 ticks.
